quote: Can can you hold for a moment? Can you I got it. Just give me one moment.
stewart_read: Household interruption early in the call; the rep proceeds without re-establishing full attention before continuing the verify sequence.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep could not control the interruption and reasonably waited it out — this may be circumstantial rather than a rep failure.
coaching_implication: When a customer steps away mid-call, briefly re-confirm they're back and ready before resuming qualifying questions, rather than talking through the gap.

quote: Still we are waiting for our one bill. We have not received anything yet.
stewart_read: Customer hands the rep a clean opening to pivot to an alternative bill-capture path (utility website, prior home's bill, estimate) but the rep just moves to the next question.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have judged the bill genuinely unobtainable (new move-in) and deliberately deferred capture to the specialist call.
coaching_implication: Ask for even a rough monthly estimate or the prior home's bill as a proxy instead of dropping the anchor entirely.

quote: Oh, how long have you lived in the home since 2019?
stewart_read: Rep abandons the bill question entirely rather than offering the schema's texted/emailed alternative path.
coaching_implication: Bill collection has a scripted branch (text/email the bill) that was never attempted here — should be run before moving on.

quote: we will decide, that how much is there because we'll have to evaluate how much you are going to charge me monthly and how much I'm getting the the bill of, Fortnite
stewart_read: This is a live cost-comparison condition on the appointment holding — essentially a soft cost objection — and the rep does not flip or address it, just confirms the day.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may be deliberately deferring the cost conversation to the specialist, which is scope-appropriate; but no acknowledgment at all leaves the condition dangling.
coaching_implication: Even a brief acknowledgment ('the specialist will show you exactly that comparison') would close this loop instead of leaving it unaddressed.

quote: I just got a few questions to get started on your design. Is that okay?
stewart_read: Rep did establish company name and form reference at 00:06, but skips the interest question entirely, losing the emotional anchor the verify section is designed to create.
coaching_implication: Ask 'what interested you in solar' before diving into address/title/roof mechanics — it's the anchor for everything that follows.

quote: Okay. Alright. Thank you. Thank you so much.
stewart_read: Button-up skips the one-hour block statement, the no-driving/computer instruction, and the 'is that fair' handshake — only a reminder text is promised.
coaching_implication: Run the full button-up: confirm the hour block, no-driving expectation, and get a verbal 'does that work' before ending the call.
